newsitem.title: USA: Eagle-Picher sees end to reorganization.
newsitem.headline: Eagle-Picher sees end to reorganization.

text.p: Eagle-Picher Industries said Friday it could emerge from its bankruptcy reorganization by November 30, the end of its fiscal year.
"Business prospects are good and the company has many new capital projects which are expected to generate above average returns on capital," it said.
The company reported net income per share of $49.13 for the third quarter of the year, a significant increase from the $4.82 for the same period in 1995.
Its reorganization is based on a $2.0 billion settlement for the company's liability for asbestos-related personal injury claims.
